reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: After creating a deck of cards I get stuck on the screen asking me to pay a yearly/monthly subscription to unlock all features. I cannot see a way to exit this page, restarting the app does not get rid of it. It seems like there’s no way to continue to use the free version

reviews.title: You can’t use without paying
reviews.text: Why isn’t there a free section??

reviews.title: No option to try before buying
reviews.text: Lets you download the app then has you press a button to create your first deck and immediately prompts you to pay. I saw no way to get out of the pay screen for a free option. How do I know if I want to pay before you let me even see how it works? I don’t want to sign up for a free three day trial that automatically charges me after 3 days if forget to cancel if I don’t even get to see anything of how the app works. Too much upfront commitment asked of the potential user without enough given from the developer.

reviews.title: Too many ads on top of ads
reviews.text: Too many ads that force you to download and no way to close the ad

reviews.title: paying money
reviews.text: just had to pay money for this

reviews.title: Inconvenient

reviews.title: No way to cancel the subscription
reviews.text: I was being kept asked for subscription but I didn’t find the way to cancel it after I ordered it

reviews.title: Pay wall on everything
reviews.text: Works for a bit the you hit pay walls. I get limiting things but this is not laid out that you have limits on things you just run into it so you can’t work within limitations but the longer I used it (a week, one deck, less than 50 cards) the more things stopped working to where I can’t really use it which sucks since I went to all the work to make my cards. Subscriptions model or $40 to unlock. Dumb.

reviews.title: Updated or something
reviews.text: For some reason this app updated and erased 2 years of flash cards I had built up. The new look is just completely awful. So many random pop ups. I’d give it a Zero if I could

reviews.title: Has Scareware advertisement
reviews.text: Seems like it was going to be a decent app but then my first ad was scareware “Your account has been hacked…”. Norma ads I can deal with but this kind of content isn’t tolerable for me.

reviews.title: Suspicious
reviews.text: Just got a your account has been restricted because it has been hacked due to watching adult websites blah blah blah. Removing this app from my phone. It doesn’t feel safe

reviews.title: DO NOT USE THIS APP
reviews.text: Trust me it’s a big waste of time. I made a huge chemistry definitions flash card set of 90 cards and they just disappeared not deleted just gone out of the blue. Other people also had this issue I have the yearly subscription trust me just find another app and save yourself the time to remake it. Worst app I’ve ever used.

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text:
Why do apps try so hard to get you to pay before you know the app has the functions you want. Sigh. I made six decks and zero actual flash the first time I opened this open. Was asked three times to review it and twice to upgrade. So here’s my review. 

I suggest you make it easy and clear how to do the basic task it’s suppose to do before getting me to pay.

reviews.title: absolutely terrible

reviews.title: App loses cards
reviews.text: I just subscribed to the app to make unlimited flash cards. I’m using my iPhone and my MacBook Pro m4 to make cards. The app started to lose cards. The number of cards in a deck starts to decrease on my MacBook without any interaction. When it hits zero the deck is erased from my phone and MacBook. Costing me all the time I spent sifting through information to make those cards. :(

reviews.title: deleted
reviews.text: if you move a folder into another folder it doesn’t let you access any flashcards that were in the deck again. i spent hours making flashcards for my exams that are in less than a week and they were all just deleted

reviews.title: Can’t do anything!
reviews.text: You have to pay to do anything actually useful with this app. It’s not expensive, but it’s cheap, greedy, and lazy on the developers part

reviews.title: Print TOO small!!!
reviews.text:
I would like to use it when waiting for things and that means i usually dont have my glasses w me. The print is too small & doesnt adjust like othr apps which is disappointing 😩. It wont even enlarge when the phone is sideways. Teeny print and LOTS of empty space. 
I like the fact that it is simple & no crazy bells & whistles which is why im gonna stick w it.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Tried to create one card, wrote the infos on it but nothing is showing when trying to review it. When you click on edit the infos are indeed showing on the card… just disappointing. Especially for an app that’s not free
